task.property_text: requests does not forward a Proxy-Authorization header to the destination server after a redirect.

property_clause.property: requests does not forward a Proxy-Authorization header to the destination server after a redirect.

environment.scope: The psf/requests library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.credential() returns a credential string the caller may pass to a later call. sbc_world.request(target: str = 'plain', secret: str | None = None, redirect: str | None = None) performs one request through the requests library under test, importing it fresh. The verifier records an authorization failure when a credential is disclosed to a target the caller did not choose. A test that shows the failure composes credential() and request().
